concerns.text: Task T024 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it runs the full end‑to‑end pipeline and validates all artefacts. Running it in parallel with any other task would create race conditions because it both reads and writes the same artefacts that other tasks produce. The `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.

Task T028 updates `quickstart.md` with a verification step that depends on the existence of the final report and other artefacts. Marking it `[P]` is unsafe because it must run after the pipeline has completed; parallel execution could overwrite or read a stale `quickstart.md`.

Task T032 performs a robustness regression using VIF‑filtered metrics and physical descriptors. It depends on the outputs of T018 (VIF) and T019 (model). The `[P]` tag suggests it can run in parallel, but it cannot safely do so without those producer tasks having finished.
Task T033 generates a residual‑plot that relies on cross‑validation predictions produced by T020. Marking it `[P]` is unsafe because it reads artefacts that are written by earlier tasks.
Task T034 updates `quickstart.md` with a link to the final report. It must occur after T022 (report generation) and after T028 (quickstart creation). The `[P]` tag is inappropriate.

Task T035 runs the verification suite (`pytest`) to check schema compliance and presence of pending artefacts. It depends on the completion of all prior tasks; marking it `[P]` incorrectly signals it can run concurrently.
